asked.item: Get all four photos out on Threads in one post
Meaning of the error "Threads only supports a single image or a video"
Using the copied API request with four images
Doing it without the API, in the Blotato app

verdict.reason: The help pages state that a Threads post takes one image and that multiple images are shared as a thread with one image per post, which answers the customer's question about getting all four photos out.

steps.text: Blotato's Threads publisher accepts only one image or video per post, so a single Threads post cannot hold all four photos.
To share multiple images on Threads, publish a thread instead, with one image attached to each post in the thread.
In the API request, put each extra image in its own post inside the additionalPosts array in post.content, with a single item in that post's mediaUrls.
In the Blotato app, click + Add Post and select Threads, attach a photo with "Add Media," then click "+ Add to Thread" to add more posts, attaching one photo to each.
